body.raw:
Software Engineer specializing in backend systems, distributed data pipelines, and autonomous AI workflows. Currently at Visa, building agentic AI for autonomous security remediation.

I hold an MSc in Artificial Intelligence from Nanyang Technological University (NTU) and an MSc in Mechanical Engineering from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST). Previously at Crédit Agricole CIB, designed and delivered large-scale real-time banking data ingestion pipelines in Java.

At Works Applications, I designed and implemented EBM, a Google Drive-like document platform using Elasticsearch and DynamoDB, and worked on Datagate and document RAG question answering.

Outside of software engineering, I'm an avid runner.
